name: 2b2e
description:
2b2e is a Minecraft Bedrock Edition anarchy server founded on the 25th of March 2020. 2b2e is one of the oldest anarchy servers in Minecraft Bedrock Edition. As the server has virtually no rules or authority, griefing and hacking are common amongst players, with no risk at all of getting banned. 2b2e has an infinite map size, no admin abuse and no gameplay rules. The map is persistent, there are no resets.
